_comment: Context budget of the agent in UTF-8 bytes, checked by harness/core/scripts/context_budget.py. kinds: imports (a file with its @imports), files (a fixed list), skills (descriptions of .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md), memory (agent memory of this project on this machine). A limit is raised on purpose, by an ordinary change; over 90% is a reason to clean up, not to raise.
